text:
alex: FYI Zenith flagged a 14-day slip on H200 batch. We have 50 units queued (32 NA, 18 EU). Vendor offered a partial RMA: 20 refurbished units available immediately to NA for a refurb fee + freight. Decision needed: accept refurb to preserve NA capacity or wait for originals? @kevin @maria

maria: Is 14 days firm? Can vendor stagger shipments (some earlier docs)? Need exact serial split.

elaine (Zenith Logistics): New ETA ~2026-04-15 (was 2026-04-01). We can immediate-ship 20 refurb to NA. Fee $350/unit + freight. AWB tentative ZLX-20260402-NA-01.

kevin: If NA loses 32 we drop below 5% spare on east cluster. Accepting 20 refurb helps but we still need another 12 fast. Ops wise, prefer partial refurb into bonded cross-dock so we can tag as temp pool.

tara: Agree. Route refurbished via bonded X-dock, tag as 'temp-na', 30-day return. For EU units, push originals and pre-clear customs paperwork.

defon: I'll automate inventory tagging. Will need PO amendment reference and RMA id. Sample assign command:
inv assign --pool temp-na --sku H200 --count 20 --tag rma_refurb_apr26

matt: Customs note: bonded X-dock avoids duties until allocation final. Vendor must mark paperwork 'refurbished components' to help tariff class. @elaine confirm?

elaine (Zenith Logistics): Can do. We'll mark commercial invoice accordingly and route through bonded warehouse. Manifest pending.

finance-bot: High-level: waiting 14d cost estimate ~ $2.8k/day risk. Refurb path (fee + expedited freight) ~ $17k total. Likely cheaper than SLA/regression cost given current traffic.

alex: Plan: accept 20 refurbished -> NA via bonded cross-dock. Hold remaining 30 for original shipment. Action items: @devon run tagging script, @maria update PO with refurb fee and finance center, @kevin shift noncritical training off east cluster. I'll open RMA.

ops-bot: RMA created: RMA-8921. Status: pending vendor pickup. Link: https://rma.internal/RMA-8921

maria: PO updated, cost center infra-temp. Uploading amended PO now.

kevin: Will throttle noncritical jobs and shift some load to west reserve. Monitoring for >5% error or latency increase.

alex: Thanks team. If vendor re-adjusts we'll reconvene. :thumbsup:
